description.raw: '''Active - Slice:''' '''Renekton''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] a fixed distance in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies he passes through.
description.text: Active - Slice: Renekton dashes a fixed distance in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies he passes through.

description2.raw: If '''Renekton''' hits an enemy, he can recast ''Slice and Dice'' within the next 4 seconds.
description2.text: If Renekton hits an enemy, he can recast Slice and Dice within the next 4 seconds.

description3.raw: '''Recast - Dice:''' '''Renekton''' repeats the first cast's effects.
description3.text: Recast - Dice: Renekton repeats the first cast's effects.

description4.raw: Both casts generate [[File:Fury resource.png|20px|link=Manaless#Fury|An icon representing the keyword Fury]] [[:Manaless#Fury|2 Fury]] for each non-champion hit and 10 Fury for each champion hit, up to 30 total per cast.
description4.text: Both casts generate 2 Fury for each non-champion hit and 10 Fury for each champion hit, up to 30 total per cast.

description5.raw: '''[[File:Renekton Reign of Anger.png|20xpx|border|link=Renekton#Reign of Anger|An icon for Renekton's ability Reign of Anger]] [[Renekton#Reign of Anger|Reign of Anger]] Bonus:''' ''Dice'', the recast, deals '''bonus''' physical damage and inflicts [[File:Armor penetration icon.svg|15px|link=Armor penetration]] armor reduction to enemies hit for 4 seconds.
description5.text: Reign of Anger Bonus: Dice, the recast, deals bonus physical damage and inflicts  armor reduction to enemies hit for 4 seconds.
